market_question: Will West Ham be relegated from the English Premier League after the 2025–26 season?
reasoning: West Ham are a stable Premier League club that finished 9th in 2023–24 and are mid‑table in 2024–25; relegation in a single season is a low‑probability event (historically ~10%) for a club with their resources. The market-implied 34.5% chance is massively overpriced, even when factoring in the possibility they are not in the 2025–26 Premier League (which would auto‑resolve No). The true P(Yes) is closer to 10%, making No heavily favored.
evidence_points: West Ham United finished 9th in the 2023–24 Premier League and are comfortably mid‑table in 2024–25, far from the relegation zone.
Bookmakers consistently price West Ham’s relegation odds in single‑digit percentages, reflecting their financial strength and squad depth.
If West Ham are relegated in 2024–25, the market resolves No; if they survive, the 2025–26 relegation risk for an established club remains well under 15%.
